title: NetShield
oneLiner: Real-time phishing URL detection & security classification engine.
problem: Phishing websites rapidly mutate domain patterns, making traditional static blocklists ineffective against zero-day social engineering threats.
approach: Engineered a multi-stage URL inspection pipeline extracting lexical features, structural anomalies, and real-time host reputation to classify threats before browser execution.
architectureDetails: Lexical feature extractor parsing path entropy, subdomains, and obfuscated tokens
Random Forest & XGBoost classification models tuned for low false-positive rates
Asynchronous REST API deployment hosted on Render with instant threat scoring
outcomes: Deployed live production service at netshield-67le.onrender.com
Led 4-member CodeGuardians developer team from architecture to deployment

title: SupplyLens360
oneLiner: Multi-tier supply chain risk intelligence & dependency graph engine.
problem: Modern manufacturing supply chains lack visibility beyond Tier-1 suppliers, making it impossible to forecast systemic bottlenecks during regional disruptions.
approach: Constructed a directed acyclic graph (DAG) representation of multi-tier supplier networks coupled with D3.js interactive traversal to simulate tier-N failure cascades.
architectureDetails: Graph traversal algorithm evaluating node centrality and critical path vulnerability
Interactive D3.js network visualizer highlighting affected downstream nodes
Real-time risk scoring matrix aggregating geographic and supplier dependency weights
outcomes: Built working interactive multi-tier graph simulation under hackathon constraints

title: CareChain
oneLiner: Automated medical resource allocation & donation-matching classifier.
problem: Emergency healthcare donation platforms struggle with delayed request matching, leading to misallocated critical medical supplies.
approach: Designed a request routing engine that categorizes inventory urgency, geographic proximity, and donor offers for priority fulfillment.
architectureDetails: Rule-based classification & priority queue algorithm for urgent medical dispatch
Modular full-stack web architecture separating transaction logic from inventory views
RESTful API design for supplier verification and donation claim tracking
outcomes: Co-engineered functional end-to-end medical dispatch portal with Siyam Bubere
Verified GitHub source code repository published

title: NextStop
oneLiner: High-concurrency railway booking & reservation state machine.
problem: Railway booking systems require atomic seat reservations and deterministic state management during concurrent booking and cancellation transactions.
approach: Developed a relational backend schema and transaction state machine enforcing ACID guarantees across station routing, seat allocation, and waitlists.
architectureDetails: Transactional state engine managing Reserved, Waitlisted, and Cancelled transitions
Optimized query indexing for station route lookups and seat availability checks
Clean separation of administrative schedules and passenger booking portals
outcomes: Solo architectural build managing end-to-end reservation lifecycle logic
Verified source repository available on GitHub

title: Zentrix
oneLiner: Clinically-inspired cognitive diagnostic engine using Fault Tree Analysis & Knowledge DAGs.
problem: Traditional learning systems fail to mathematically identify precise student cognitive misconceptions, often relying on static question banks or hallucination-prone LLM tutors.
approach: Engineered a clinically-inspired diagnostic engine using Fault Tree Analysis (FTA), Knowledge DAGs, and Item Response Theory (IRT) to adaptively evaluate student ability.
architectureDetails: Built a clinically-inspired diagnostic engine using Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) and Knowledge DAGs to mathematically identify student cognitive gaps with zero hallucinations.
Implemented Item Response Theory (IRT) for latent ability estimation, enabling the system to select questions calibrated to each student’s edge of knowledge.
Orchestrated remediation logic via a Behavior Tree sequencer that dynamically switches between Drill, Remedy, and Advance modes based on real-time fatigue metrics and calibration state.
outcomes: Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) & Knowledge DAGs mathematically isolating cognitive gaps with zero hallucinations
Item Response Theory (IRT) calibration selecting optimal questions at student's edge of knowledge
Behavior Tree sequencer orchestrating adaptive Drill, Remedy, and Advance modes

title: MedLearn
oneLiner: Intelligent medical domain learning & RAG query system (In Progress).
problem: Clinical reference documentation is dense and domain-heavy, making rapid point-of-care query retrieval prone to context loss.
approach: Building a domain-specific retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) system utilizing vector embeddings optimized for medical terminology.
architectureDetails: Chunking pipeline tailored for clinical papers and treatment protocols
Vector store retrieval index with hybrid dense/sparse search scoring
Citation-backed answer generator designed to ground model responses in source texts
outcomes: Active development phase — evaluation benchmarking under construction

title: Forum Website
oneLiner: Collaborative discussion portal with dynamic thread indexing.
role: Solo Project (started as first-year group project)
problem: Peer-to-peer technical knowledge sharing requires structured topic organization, searchability, and scalable post categorization.
approach: Built a web discussion engine featuring hierarchical category navigation, user posting privileges, and responsive thread rendering.
architectureDetails: Relational data model linking users, categories, threads, and threaded replies
Session authentication and role-based moderation authorization
Client-side search filtering across thread titles and tags
outcomes: Evolved from a VJTI 1st-year engineering course project into an expanded codebase

title: JusticeGrid
oneLiner: Legal tech workflow automation & case intake platform.
problem: Legal aid intake processes suffer from manual document sorting and slow client request triage.
approach: Designed a streamlined digital intake dashboard that categorizes case details and routes urgent filings to legal advisors.
architectureDetails: Form intake workflow with dynamic field validation based on legal case classification
Structured dashboard view for case triaging and status updates
Clean UI layout prioritizing accessibility and mobile intake clarity
outcomes: Built during hackathon; repository preparing for public release
